title: Flue 1.0 Beta
brief: Flue 1.0 Beta announcement — "the open framework for building agents without lab lock-in: write once, deploy..." Details beyond the embed preview are unverified.
details: This post announces Flue 1.0 Beta, the open-source TypeScript framework for building autonomous agents and workflows with zero lock-in, designed by the creators of Astro. The beta unifies two primitives — fully autonomous stateful Agents (defined by context: model, tools, skills, sandbox, instructions) and deterministic Workflows where trusted code drives the model — plus Channels that drop agents into Slack, GitHub, and Linear, a React UI library (@flue/react), a revamped SDK, durable agents that recover from downtime via an append-only event log, and OpenTelemetry observability. Note the page carries an update: the surface has since been redesigned around a Vite plugin, so this post is preserved as written with a migration guide linked.
